rationale: The assistant correctly identified the gurgling, clicks and cracks as normal refrigerant, cycling and expansion/defrost noises, matching the hidden truth, with hedged language ('probably not faulty') and no invented facts or parts. It failed to confirm the key unknowns (cooling temperatures, level, clearance, absence of loud buzzing/grinding) before reassuring, asking no questions at all, and gave only a vague fallback ('Unless you notice the fridge getting warm or see any leaks') rather than pointing to Bosch warranty if abnormal noises develop. Still, a UK homeowner would be reasonably well served and not misled.
